patch_description: Reorganizes term construction around each demanded origin–destination pair: it evaluates all eligible two-hop intermediates, scores them using relay pressure and direct-edge load, then normalizes their support so promising routes are favored without rewarding every alternative equally. Direct-link rewards remain separate, and helper functions isolate input preparation, relay scoring and QUBO assembly for easier maintenance. The number of quadratic terms remains at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\).
